description: Defines IPC provisioning classes and message types, including KeyValue class for data serialization, with conditional debug timeout enum.

classes.name: KeyValue
classes.description: A class for managing a byte buffer with serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the current size of data in the buffer.

methods.name: Frame
methods.description: Sets the buffer content from a byte stream.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes buffer content into a byte stream with offset and max length.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into the buffer, expanding buffer if needed.
